description:
Medical staffing in Georgia's prisons under the Department of Corrections' contract with Centurion
    of Georgia LLC: the hours the contract's staffing matrix requires vs the hours Centurion reports
    working, by prison, job and month, July-December 2025, plus the workbook's own understaffing-penalty
    calculation. From Centurion's "GA-MED Productive hours compared to Matrix" workbook, produced by GDC
    under an open-records request (R032595-101926, October 2026). No individuals are named.
    level: contract (system totals and quarterly penalty rows) | facility (one entry per prison, lowest
    share of contracted hours first; or one prison) | position (one prison by job, or a job across prisons)
    | matrix (the contracted staffing in force from March 1, 2026, Amendment 4's Exhibit 3.1: every site's
    full-time equivalents, or one site by shift and job).
    facility: a prison slug (dooly-state-prison), id or name fragment ('Walker'). position: e.g. 'RN',
    'LPN', 'NP/PA'. month: YYYY-MM. Read the returned caveats: medical only (not mental health or dental);
    the penalty figures are the workbook's calculation and do not show whether GDC collected them.
name: get_health_staffing
title: Get health staffing
